mentions.name: Mooring (macOS RDP client)
mentions.description: A macOS RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol) client that improves on the native macOS tooling, adding retina full screen scaling, automatic reconnection, and network measurement that downgrades connection quality when necessary.
mentions.problem: Solves gripes with the native macOS RDP tooling.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on macOS RDP client that solve some of my gripes with the native tooling. Brings retina full screen scaling, auto reconnect, and measures network to downgrade if necessary.

evidence.value: I've been working on macOS RDP client that solve some of my gripes with the native tooling. Brings retina full screen scaling, auto reconnect, and measures network to downgrade if necessary.
